Running command: cd /workspace
# Create test inputs - first byte is action, rest is JSON
# Action 0 = get_string
printf '\x00["\\u' > test1.bin
printf '\x00["\\ud800\\u' > test2.bin
printf '\x00["\\ud800\\udc00' > test3.bin
printf '\x00["\\u123' > test4.bin
printf '\x00["\\u1234' > test5.bin
printf '\x00["\\u' > test6.bin
printf '\x00["\\ud800\\ud800' > test7.bin
printf '\x00["\\udc00' > test8.bin
printf '\x00["\\ud800\\u\\u' > test9.bin
printf '\x00["\\ud800\\ud800\\u' > test10.bin

for f in test*.bin; do
  echo "=== Testing $f ==="
  ./test_fuzz "$f" 2>&1 | head -5
  echo "Exit: $?"
done
